# KithMoot

> Group calls and chat over an incumbent's servers mean an operator holds the
> guest list, the history and the room state. KithMoot is a workspace with
> rooms, chat, files and calls built on Nostr, where membership is whoever
> holds the link, not an account on someone else's server.

KithMoot groups by participant rather than by connection: a phone and a
laptop from the same person are one tile with two tracks, not two strangers.
An agent joins the same link a person was sent, on the same terms, and says
it is one. It is for anyone who wants a Slack-and-Jitsi-grade workspace
without a server that can be shut down, subpoenaed or read. Live at
[kithmoot.forgesworn.dev](https://kithmoot.forgesworn.dev/) (app under `/j/`).

## Getting Started

```bash
git clone https://github.com/forgesworn/kithmoot.git
cd kithmoot
npm ci
npm run build:lib
npm test
npm run demo   # HTTPS dev server, phone-friendly
```

Or drive a room headlessly: `npm run agent -- --help` (see `kithmoot-agent`).

## Key Concepts

- **Room**: derived from a shared secret in the join link; a relay only sees
  opaque identifiers, never contents or names.
- **Participant identity**: a pubkey plus an async `signEvent`
  (`ParticipantIdentity` in `src/identity.ts`); satisfied by a locally
  generated key or an external Nostr signer.
- **Device credential**: what a paired device signs to join an existing
  participant's tiles, scoped to one room and time-limited.
- **Agent**: a `RoomAgent` (`src/agent.ts`) that joins a room the same way a
  browser does, with one addition: it declares that it is an agent.
- **Epoch**: the room's rekeying unit, used to rotate admins and channel
  keys without changing the live room (`src/epoch.ts`).

## API Surface

Main entry point: `src/index.ts`.

- `deriveRoom`, `generateRoomSecret`, `encodeJoinUrl`, `decodeJoinUrl`: create
  and encode a room.
- `parseRoomLink`, `encodeRoomLink`: the join link itself.
- `RoomAgent`, `AGENT_CHANNEL`, `TRANSCRIPT_CHANNEL`, `MINUTES_CHANNEL`: the
  headless agent runtime.
- `verifyEventUncached`, `KINDS`: protocol event kinds and verification.
- `importBoundedHistory`, `historyImportRequest`: bounded history import
  between devices.
- `deriveEpoch`, `encodeRekeyEvent`, `hostRoomEpoch`, `requestRoomEpoch`: room
  rekeying.

CLIs: `kithmoot-agent` (join a room without a browser), `kithmoot-context`
(context extraction), `kithmoot-forwarder` (`server/forwarder.mjs`).
